a.statement: Hess psi = D^{-1}/2 - S2^{-1} in m-coordinates
a.basis: dm/d(ln mu) = S2 (exact Euler identity), S2 PD (spectra span R^4), S2^{-1} m = 1/5 from S2 1 = 5 m (exact); grad psi = ln m/2 - ln mu + 3/10 reproduces paper (5.19)

b.statement: slice {sum m = c}: Hessian ND at m(mu) <=> u^T S2 u < 2 u^T D u for all u != 0 with <u,m> = 0
b.basis: in scaled coordinates S^ = D^{-1/2} S2 D^{-1/2} has eigenvector sqrt(m) (eigenvalue 5, from S2 1 = 5 m), so sqrt(m)^perp is S^-invariant and the compression of S^^{-1} equals the inverse of the compression; slice Hessian eigenvalues (metric D^{-1}) are lambda_i = 1/2 - 1/r_i with r_i the generalised eigenvalues of (S2|D) on m^perp
b.caveat: 'strictly concave at m(mu) iff' should read 'slice Hessian negative definite at m(mu) iff' (ND => local strict concavity, converse false in general); the switch 1^perp -> m^perp relies on all spectra having entry sum 5

c.statement: condition (b) <=> Mpoly 1 = 0 and leading 3x3 block of Mpoly PD
